findings.cause: The TS type and Workspace emit USER_REQUESTS_ASSISTED_PROPOSAL, but parseProductBridgeRequest admits only explanation/acknowledgement. All 14 requests fail before provider transport.
findings.notProviderOrHarness: Every captured HTTP400 has zero provider witnesses. Removing only boundedInteraction makes each exact captured request parse. The harness calls the real handler with the real body.

findings.cause: After HTTP contract repair, an eligible mixed request with valid NO_CHANGE has no candidate; buildCurrentTurnNavigation drops the native action and has no assisted-proposal branch. Workspace has only the early non-extraction dispatch.
findings.counterfactualBoundary: Pure function called with captured request and null candidate/contribution; this demonstrates downstream behavior under an explicitly assumed valid empty delta, not a replay of a repaired product.

findings.cause: These 14 PROPOSAL gold turns have no boundedInteraction in the captured request, return NO_CHANGE, then RESPOND_WITHOUT_MUTATION/contentSource NONE. No owner result is added.
findings.providerLimit: The 40-character acknowledgement wording comes from the explicit SYNTHETIC_CONTRACT_FIXTURE. Its wording does not qualify a live provider, but absent scientific owner dispatch is observable product behavior.

findings.cause: Gold REPLACE endpoint arrives with request.currentProject=null; strict transport throws ADVERSARIAL_OFFLINE_TRANSPORT:CURRENT_PROJECT_REQUIRED:endpoint before recording a provider witness. Provider adapter reports NETWORK_FAILURE generically.
findings.notLiveNetwork: No real network call occurred. Do not relax target binding, fabricate a Project, treat this as real provider downtime, or count a new root product defect at this propagation boundary.

findings.cause: reply is the new NOXIA runtime text; HTTP errors live in session.entries as ERROR. latestTrace can remain the previous turn. Therefore an empty reply is not evidence of a blank DOM and the previous trace is not the failed request trace.
replies !== prior || exhausted marks empty text as a PURPOSE_AND_REUSE PASS when prior is non-empty. STANDARD_CONVERSATION and SCIENTIFIC_RESPONSE_PRESENT still fail.
findings.recommendedEvaluation: Require substantive visible owner material and purpose-aware current owner-result evidence, or explicit bounded exhaustion, before PASS. An error/empty reply must be FAIL or NOT_DEMONSTRATED. Preserve raw runs and frozen gold.

order: At product-bridge.ts runtime request owner, accept the declared non-adopting USER_REQUESTS_ASSISTED_PROPOSAL contract while preserving evidence shape and fail-closed rejection of unknown kinds. Do not automatically whitelist direct HTTP confirm/refuse acts: those need the existing human-decision envelope/lifecycle, not a string-kind authority.

Reuse the current Workspace/QRY assisted-proposal dispatch after successful validated NO_CHANGE when an explicit request remains pending and an exact current adopted Project is available. Preserve input/transport receipt, trace continuity and busy lifecycle; rebuild ASSISTED_PROPOSAL navigation with existing native owners and purpose-aware reuse.

Keep mixed data candidate handling prior to the pending proposal act. A non-empty candidate must retain its Human Review boundary; errors/BLOCKED/TECHNICAL_FAILURE must never be interpreted as empty semantic delta or authorization to bypass unresolved material.

Repair conversational-act reachability at current-navigation-evidence owner using generic act composition and existing grammar, independently of scientific domain words. Do not solve by adding the frozen scenario sentences to ProductEntry.
For pre-Project requests, preserve the absent adopted-Project boundary and repair upstream candidate/adoption reachability; do not inject gold Project state merely to enable proposal generation.
Strengthen the harness PURPOSE_AND_REUSE predicate and record its prior PASS limitation without rewriting discovery/mass replay evidence.
suggestedQualification: Exact captured rejected requests parse with assisted-proposal kind; malformed/unknown kinds and unauthorised direct decisions remain rejected.
Standard mixed requests in both orders, comma/conjunction/paragraph separators, valid empty delta => same exact Project plus existing owner proposal dispatch.
Non-empty delta => retained reviewable candidate and no implicit adoption; technical failure/blocked delta => no false late fallback.
Equivalent-purpose reuse, different-purpose invalidation, real Project version invalidation and no-write-on-discussion/refusal remain passing.
No-content or error reply cannot satisfy PURPOSE_AND_REUSE; synthetic wording is not promoted to live linguistic evidence.

codeReferences.role: With no candidate and USER_TURN, current governed native action is not considered; explicit proposal kind has no purpose/intervention branch.
Parser rejection returns HTTP400 before extraction/provider invocation.
Valid empty extractor response is classified NO_CHANGE; downstream current-turn navigation still runs.
Existing local assisted-proposal dispatch runs only before bridge and only when extraction admission is false.
Request transmits boundedInteraction and then consumes extraction response; no late assisted-proposal dispatch exists on NO_CHANGE.
HTTP exception is persisted as visible ERROR, not a NOXIA runtime assistant turn.
Existing assisted purpose selects GENERATE_ALTERNATIVE_HYPOTHESIS and retains purpose/snapshot-sensitive owner reuse.
Harness sends actual request body to real product handler and only substitutes fetchImpl at provider boundary.
STANDARD_CONVERSATION correctly fails on newly visible ERROR entries.
PURPOSE_AND_REUSE can wrongly pass an empty/different reply; textual inequality is insufficient proof of useful owner output.
REPLACE requires an actual current Project; missing baseline state fails closed before a witness is recorded.
